heading: Settings
hotkeyHint: Press to type, hold to talk
morningHint: At this time every day, the agent plans your day
eveningHint: At this time every day, talk about how the day went
hotkeyHintPressOnly: Press to type. Holding to talk doesn't work on this computer.

models.automatic: Not picked yet; this one works for now
models.none: No model to use yet. Connect one under Model providers below.
models.backgroundHint: Work Jezo starts on its own, like sorting notes, can use a cheaper or faster model.
models.others: Models for background work and small tasks
models.smallHint: Small things like naming a conversation. Apple's on-device model can be picked here: private and quick, but it takes memory beside the main model.
models.tooSmallHint: A conversation needs about {{needed}}K; this model holds less
models.mainTooSmall: This model reads {{has}}K at a time, and a conversation of yours needs about {{needed}}K, so it may stop partway

providers.title: Model providers
providers.intro: Where Jezo gets its models. Ones running on this computer (LM Studio, Ollama) are found on their own; for the others, paste a key.
providers.localMissing: {{name}} wasn't found. Open it, load a model, then press Refresh.
providers.checkFailed: Didn't work; check the key, the address or the model.
providers.name: Name
providers.addressHint: A server that speaks the OpenAI API; the address usually ends in /v1
providers.importHint: Copies keys, your own servers and the default model from your own pi (~/.pi/agent). It's read only when you press this.

imported.skipped: Didn't import {{names}}: not an OpenAI-style API, or its key comes from running a command.

apple.available: Runs on this Mac, and nothing leaves it. Jezo uses it for small tasks, like naming conversations. It can read too little at once to run a full conversation with the agent.
apple.unsupported-system: Requires macOS 26 or later and an Apple Silicon Mac.
apple.device-not-eligible: Apple Intelligence is not supported on this Mac.
apple.intelligence-disabled: Turn on Apple Intelligence in System Settings, then refresh here.
apple.model-not-ready: Apple Intelligence is still preparing its model. Refresh here once the download finishes.
apple.unavailable: Apple Intelligence is unavailable right now. Check System Settings, then refresh here.
apple.helper-unavailable: The Apple model could not be loaded. Try refreshing, or update Jezo.
apple.noModels: The on-device model will appear when Apple Intelligence is available.

atLogin.title: Open in the background at login
atLogin.hint: Automations run while the computer’s awake, without opening the window first. Quitting Jezo still quits it.

about.title: About Jezo
about.tagline: A local-first personal agent that helps turn your goals into plans and follow-through so you can focus on the present.
about.licenseHint: Open source: free to use, modify and distribute.
about.starHint: Give it a star on GitHub, so more people who need it can find it.

reminders.title: Deadline reminders
reminders.hint: Once, at 6 pm the day before a deadline, or 3 hours before a deadline with a time. Not once it’s done or dropped.

speech.title: Speech recognition
speech.installHint: Voice input with ⌥X needs a speech recognition (ASR) model. Installing creates a Python environment and downloads the default engine and model.
speech.needsUv: Requires uv (a Python package manager) to be installed first.
speech.noModel: No model selected. Select one to use voice input
speech.modelBroken: {{model}} can't be loaded. Check its settings
speech.intro: Choose the speech recognition (ASR) model used for voice input with ⌥X. Models are provided by installed Standard ASR engines; installing an engine makes its models available.
speech.oldCore: The installed Standard ASR is outdated and lacks session capability checks (PR 107). Recognition still works; updating it together with the engines is recommended.
speech.configurationError: This model can't be created with the current settings: {{error}}

facts.title: Capabilities
facts.liveHint: Partial results are shown while you speak.
facts.liveNoPartialsHint: Audio is sent to the model as you speak, but text appears only when you finish.
facts.afterwardsHint: The whole recording is transcribed after you release ⌥X; no text appears while recording.
facts.guidedHint: Jezo passes your todos, goals and page names to the model as context, which improves accuracy on names and terms.
facts.unguidedHint: No context can be passed, so names and terms are more likely to be misrecognized.
facts.audioBatchHint: Sent as a whole after recording ends.
facts.declared: Based on the engine's declaration. The model can't be created with the current settings, so its actual capabilities are known only once the settings are fixed.

files.title: Model files
files.none: This model needs no additional files.
files.needDownload: Not downloaded. The model can be used once the download completes.
files.needDownloadSize: Not downloaded (about {{size}}). The model can be used once the download completes.
files.blocked: Required files are missing and can't be downloaded automatically:
files.unknown: The engine can't confirm whether the files are complete. You can still try using the model.
files.refreshHint: The source may have been updated. Checking again downloads a newer version if there is one.

blocker.downloads_disabled: The engine is configured not to download (for example, “Local files only” is on).
blocker.action_required: The following steps are required first.
blocker.unsupported: The engine can't obtain this file itself; it has to be placed manually.

settings.title: Model settings
settings.intro: Unchanged settings use the engine's defaults; only the settings you change are saved.

groupHint.options: Parameters passed to the engine for each recognition (RuntimeParams).
groupHint.config: Initialization settings used when the model is created, such as the download directory and the device.
groupHint.provider: Decoding parameters specific to this engine; other engines don't accept them.
groupHint.deadlines: Timeouts for streaming recognition (StreamDeadlines). Choose No value to disable a deadline; Use default leaves it to the engine.

settings.notSaved: Not saved; the previous settings are unchanged: {{error}}
settings.unusedHint: These settings are still passed to the engine, but Jezo doesn't read their results (it records microphone audio and keeps only the recognized text), so they don't change voice input.

language.label: Language
language.hint: The language to recognize. When not set, the engine decides, usually by detecting it.

candidate_languages.label: Candidate languages
candidate_languages.hint: Restricts automatic detection to these languages. One language code per line.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.hint: Context text given to the model. When not set, Jezo provides context from your todos and conversation.

phrase_hints.label: Phrase hints
phrase_hints.hint: Terms to recognize preferentially, one per line. When not set, Jezo provides them.

on_unsupported.label: When unsupported
on_unsupported.hint: Whether to merge parameters the engine doesn't support, such as phrase hints, into the prompt.

done_timeout.label: Completion timeout (s)
done_timeout.hint: How long to wait for the final result after the audio ends.

max_idle.label: Idle timeout (s)
max_idle.hint: The session ends after this long without audio.

max_session_seconds.label: Maximum session length (s)
max_session_seconds.hint: The longest a single recognition can last.

default_language.label: Default language
default_language.hint: Used when no language is specified.

default_candidate_languages.label: Default candidate languages
default_candidate_languages.hint: The default candidates for automatic detection.

download_root.label: Download directory
download_root.hint: Where model files are stored. When not set, the engine's default cache is used.

local_files_only.label: Local files only
local_files_only.hint: When on, nothing is downloaded; only existing files are used.

revision.label: Model revision
revision.hint: A branch, tag or commit of the model source.

hf_token.label: Hugging Face token
hf_token.hint: Used to download gated models. Stored in the system keychain.

strict.label: Strict mode
strict.hint: When on, unsupported parameters cause an error; when off, they're skipped with a diagnostic.

model_path.label: Local model path
model_path.hint: A local model directory used instead of the preset's weights.

device.label: Device
device.hint: For example cpu, cuda or auto.

word_timestamps.label: Timestamps
word_timestamps.hint: Output timestamps for each word or segment.

diarization.label: Speaker diarization
diarization.hint: Label who is speaking in each segment.

allow_private_urls.label: Allow private URLs
allow_private_urls.hint: Relaxes the SSRF policy so audio may come from a private or loopback URL (HTTPS is still required).

engines.installedNothing: Installed, but no new models were found. The package may not be a Standard ASR engine.
engines.addIntro: An engine is a Python package implementing the Standard ASR protocol. Each engine provides one or more models.
engines.requirementHint: Enter a PyPI package name, a Git URL or a local path.
engines.uninstallBody_one: The model it provides will be removed from the list. Downloaded model files are kept, so reinstalling doesn't download them again.
engines.uninstallBody_other: The {{count}} models it provides will be removed from the list. Downloaded model files are kept, so reinstalling doesn't download them again.
engines.uninstallActive: The model currently in use belongs to this engine; you'll need to select another one.

updates.title: Updates
updates.intro: Selected packages are updated together in one dependency resolution, keeping Standard ASR and the engines compatible.
updates.oldCore: The installed Standard ASR is outdated; updating it together with the engines is recommended.
updates.none: All packages are up to date.
updates.mainCurrent: Standard ASR and the engines are up to date.
updates.toolsNote: Python and uv aren't updated here: uv updates with Jezo, and the Python version is listed under Environment.

diagnostics.title: Environment
diagnostics.intro: Copy this information when reporting a problem.
diagnostics.sessionHint: Diagnostics reported by engines during recognition since Jezo started. A diagnostic doesn't necessarily mean recognition failed.
